title: Function tenant context, batch 4: plugin functions (reader-steering, home-page, newsletter function and ops, notifications, signup, alexa) and cli-login-pages
description: Move these handlers to the TenantContext. Remove each from PENDING in scripts/test-function-tenant-context.ts. Spec: features_backend/function-tenant-context.feature.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reader plugins (reader-steering, home-page, signup, newsletter, notifications, alexa) and cli-login-pages: the reader API takes its tenant from the host (docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md, readers), so these move together with the TenantDomain lookup. The content-actions tasks they send (reader-snapshot, home-page-snapshot) must name the tenant on a shared stack (PPY-0a9b8c).
